title: On Announcing the winner at noon
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：announce　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 announce 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the counsellor ① announced the winner at noon without complaint, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② announces the winner at noon with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ announce the winner at noon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ announced the winner at noon before — a line in the journal for June 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Announcing the winner at noon without complaint, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ announce the change over supper with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Announce the change over supper at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ announces the change over supper without complaint every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply  announced the winner at noon again when nobody else would.

To announce the winner at noon, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody announces the winner at noon with great care again and somebody must announce the winner at noon without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 宣布（一般过去式 announced the winner at noon：1957 年谈心人头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 宣布（一般现在 announces the winner at noon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 宣布（不定式 to announce the winner at noon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 宣布（过去完成时 had announced the winner at noon：1951 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 宣布（动名词 announcing the winner at noon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 通报（announce the change over supper：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去通报晚饭时说出那次变动）
G. v. 通报（announce the change over supper：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 宣布（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 announces the change over supper，而母亲又一次 announced the winner at noon）

items.q: to announce the winner at noon
announced the winner at noon before
announce the change over supper with great care
announce the change over supper at once
announces the change over supper without complaint

answers.why: announce 意为“宣布”，1957 年谈心人毫无怨言地宣布正午宣布得胜者，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 announced。
announce 意为“宣布”，自那以后谈心人小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 announces。
announce 意为“宣布”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯宣布正午宣布得胜者”，此处为不定式 to announce the winner at noon。
announce 意为“宣布”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人宣布过，故用过去完成时 had announced。
announce 意为“宣布”，谈心人说“宣布正午宣布得胜者这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 announcing the winner at noon 作主语。
announce 意为“通报”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去通报晚饭时说出那次变动”，should ever 之后用原形 announce the change over supper。
announce 意为“通报”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻通报晚饭时说出那次变动（announce the change over supper at once），以后再也不要提起。
announce 意为“宣布”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例通报晚饭时说出那次变动，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 announces。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，谈心人毫无怨言地宣布正午宣布得胜者；小园里每一个倾听者都说这是头一回。（announced the winner at noon）
多年以后，谈心人仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（announces the winner at noon）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯宣布正午宣布得胜者这件事本身。（to announce the winner at noon）
早在 1951 年就有人宣布正午宣布得胜者，六月那天心记上的一行字就是证据。（had announced the winner at noon）
谈心人说过，毫无怨言地宣布正午宣布得胜者这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（announcing the winner at noon 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻通报晚饭时说出那次变动，以后再也不要提起。（announce the change over supper，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the counsellor announced the winner at noon without complaint, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three evenings on, the counsellor still announces the winner at noon with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to announce the winner at noon at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had announced the winner at noon long before 1964, and the line in the journal for June proves it.
Announcing the winner at noon without complaint, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Announce the change over supper at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 announce 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the counsellor announced the winner at noon without complaint, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor announces the winner at noon with great care whenever the garden asks.
Announcing the winner at noon without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever announce the change over supper with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden announces the change over supper without complaint every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother announced the winner at noon again, and the garden remembered that half.
